nie_umiem_zmierzyc.powod: the hijacked session was killed before it ended - its usage is deliberately outside both series' accounting
0.0 = deliberately not counted (a hijacked session), not a measured zero

notes: CALIBRATION PILOT, attempt 1: the dispatcher tick picked up arena ticket #86 (M6, maintenance phase; back to status/ready after a rate-limit interruption) instead of its own #87 - the arena repository's ticket pool is shared between series and the dispatch selector takes the first dispatchable ticket. The session was killed mid-run; worktree and branch removed, nothing pushed. Fix: a single-ticket guard in both drivers (E2 and maintenance), and the M-tickets moved to status/blocked for the rerun. The hijacked session's tokens are NOT counted to either arm: they measured no task.

CALIBRATION PILOT, attempt 3 (on its own ticket #87) - an infrastructure void produced by a SINGLE harness defect with three effects. The engine's error classifier scanned for the substring 'limit' across the whole event and matched the repository's MODULE NAME `ratelimit_probe`, so it reported every healthy agent session as a failure: (1) the dispatcher repeated 5 internal agent+review cycles on #87, throwing away good work each time, and gave up without a PR; (2) iteration 2 superseded the ticket to #88 and worked until it was cut off; (3) the driver aborted the run as 'limit/auth' and its emergency record was incomplete (the ledger rejected it; reconstructed here from the rollouts). ATTRIBUTION CORRECTION: the first accounting of this void ($10.33/220 req) swept in, by a time-glob, 54 sessions belonging to an unrelated production agent of the operator's that runs on THE SAME vendor account - the 'everything-the-account-did != my measurement' class (A4/E1), here on the challenger's side; caught before it was written, and only the 6 sessions whose working directory was under b2/ are counted (179 requests, reconciled per request). Fixes before attempt 4: classify by event TYPE; a void path with a complete field set plus a smoke test. These tokens do not enter the series.
